independent_review.review_scope: Independent crop fidelity to available third-party reproduction only
findings: Read CODEX_INSTRUCTIONS.md, audits/crops.md, crop-source-map.json, preparation audit and notes. Independently opened all ten full source pages and all 29 actual-output contact sheets. No crop-induced loss of available question content, diagrams, code, formulas, option labels or requested subparts found. Headers, page frames and section directions excluded without leaking unrelated questions.

Q1-Q49 map to reproduction MCQs 1-49. Q50 maps to original 3 / reproduction 50. All Q51-Q96 descriptive mappings checked by subject, shared context and task against question records and source; normalized IDs are not source printed numbers.
MCQ continuations Q4,Q13,Q17,Q22,Q25,Q35,Q38,Q42,Q47 preserve split options, diagrams and stems. Q52,Q63-Q65,Q70,Q77-Q79,Q82-Q83,Q87,Q90-Q94 preserve descriptive cross-column/page content.

Verified 55 deliberate overlapping part pairs by recomputation and visual content. Shared stems, PDA labels, timing diagrams, programs, postfix expression and line equation are retained. Q62 needs Q61 bit labels; Q70 needs Q69 20% branch frequency; Q81 needs Q80 memoization instruction; Q89 needs Q88 reader/writer code; Q94 needs Q92 redistribution; Q96 needs Q95 TP-view definition. Six nonidentical heading overlaps have exact source bounds and intersections.
All 173 current WEBP files freshly rerendered from canonical PDF at 3x quality80 and were byte-identical. All 29 viewed contacts independently rebuilt from those output files and pixel-identical.
limitations: The canonical PDF is a third-party reproduction, not an authenticated complete original exam. Missing XObject resource warnings X1/X3/X5/X7/X9/X11/X13/X15/X17/X19 were freshly reproduced and agree with source-map. The assignment mentioned Fm0, but that specific name was not observed in this review. Missing resources do not authorize reconstructing content or certifying original completeness.
Small code, formulas, operator/overbar scope and diagram labels are natively blurry. Their source appearance is preserved, not resolved or certified as a transcription.

Reproduction Q57 IN09H / DA opcode inconsistency is retained. Q64 explicitly permits nonadjacent swaps. Q62 set-call text and Q58 assembly mnemonics remain as rendered, without replacing them from another reproduction or the paraphrase. Q29 set notation and other source ambiguities remain untouched.
Approval does not verify answers, solutions, original-source fidelity, transcription accuracy, publication readiness or redistribution rights.
